programme_facts.value: Individuals from/residing in EU/EFTA/UK countries
Apply via the Central Applications Office (CAO) for EU fee eligible applicants applying for first year undergraduate degree.
Offers cannot be issued until Round 1 offers after the Irish Leaving Certificate results are released.
Eligible applicants remain on the waiting list and may be offered in order of merit in later rounds, in accordance with CAO procedures.
Non-EU fee applicants and transfer applicants (post year 1) must apply directly to the University.
Applicants whose first language is not English must provide evidence of competence in a recognised English language test.
Acceptable level of English from European countries where English is presented as a subject.
Ordinary Level Grade D or above in English.
580 (paper-based) or 90 (internet-based).
Minimum score of 6.5 with no less than 6.0 in any component.
Grade C1 in English Test for Academic and Professional Purposes.
Grade C or above in English Language/GCSE English Language.
Proficiency Certificate, Grade C or better (CEFR Level C1 or C2), Advanced Certificate, Grade C or better (CEFR Level C1 or C2), or First Certificate, Grade A (CEFR Level C1).

Oxford Delegacy of Local Examinations: Grade C, Cambridge Local Examinations Syndicate: School Certificate Pass 1-6, University of London Entrance and School Examinations Council: School Certificate Pass 1-6.
Minimum score of 61 (with no section score below 59).
Overall minimum 140. Individual skills 125.
B2 Communicator High Pass with no less than 33 in each skill.
Minimum requirement will be a DET score of 120 with at least 110 in each sub score.
16 years of age on the 15 January of the year of entry.
